To dispose of overstocks, the computerized IMMS register recording over stocks of ordinary stores desirable for sale or disposal during the next twelve months is reviewed by the PCMM every month. Monthly review keeps disposal action moving. The principle behind this is worth grasping, not just memorising: once you understand why the rule is framed this way, the answer follows naturally instead of needing rote recall.
